title: Saving your game
summary: The game saves itself every few seconds. Save & load in the menu keeps save files by name, as many as you like.
text:
Your colony **autosaves** to this browser every few seconds and whenever you leave the page, so you can close the tab and pick up again with CONTINUE on the title screen.

**Save files.** Menu → **Save & load** keeps games of your own, by name: type a name and tap SAVE. Each file shows where you were, the game time and when you saved it. Keep as many as you like: before a big decision, or one per campaign.

- **Ctrl+S** saves at once: over the file this game came from, or as a new one
- **SAVE HERE** puts this game over an older file; **RENAME**, **DELETE** (tap twice) tidy the list
- **LOAD** a campaign file and the whole campaign comes back: every region's colony, the story and research. It replaces the campaign you have now, so it asks first
- **LOAD** on the title screen lists your files too
- **Skirmish battles** can be saved the same way and finished later (the Daily Planet can't: one attempt a day)

**On another device:** files live in this browser only. **EXPORT** downloads a file as a .json; **IMPORT FILE…** on the other device (or after clearing your browser) brings it back.

- Each region you play keeps its own autosave, so your home colony and an expedition never overwrite each other
- NEW GAME starts the whole campaign over and clears the autosaves; your save files stay
